description: Header file defining the split6_flexible_o_du_low_session class, which manages a session involving O-DU low, RU, and FAPI slot message adaptor in a 5G network context.

classes.name: split6_flexible_o_du_low_session
classes.description: Manages a session that integrates FAPI slot messages, O-DU low, and RU components for a cell, handling lifecycle and adapters.

methods.name: split6_flexible_o_du_low_session
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with notifier and report period.

methods.name: set_dependencies
methods.description: Sets the dependencies for the session including adaptors, O-DU, radio, and timer.

methods.name: get_upper_ru_ul_adapter
methods.description: Returns reference to the upper PHY RU UL adapter.

methods.name: get_upper_ru_timing_adapter
methods.description: Returns reference to the upper PHY RU timing adapter.

methods.name: get_upper_ru_error_adapter
methods.description: Returns reference to the upper PHY RU error adapter.

methods.name: get_upper_ru_dl_rg_adapter
methods.description: Returns reference to the upper PHY RU downlink resource grant adapter.

methods.name: get_upper_ru_ul_request_adapter
methods.description: Returns reference to the upper PHY RU UL request adapter.
